【正式版】1.0.3版本更新内容

【重要】
搜刮度的设计已经废除，现在全程保持300%的掉率。
搜刮度改为了探索度，探索度满了后可以自动刷新本章节宝藏点。
神殿洗礼可以直接点击天赋进行锁定和解锁。
偏好技能对洗礼也会生效。
【苦痛鳞片】已经没用了，将会在下次更新返还成海渊之鳞。
怪物强度下调15%左右。
野猪首领和蘑菇首领攻击力下调15%。
为普通章节增加了掉落少量圣骨。

【优化】
市场不会再刷新重复的订单需求。
更多属性默认显示所有属性。
乌鲁克套装的护盾暂时统计到套装戒指上。
技能的标签改到了技能信息上方，更明显。

【调整】
【黑暗星辰】的合成数量减少到6个。
单独抗性词缀的价值提升了。

【正式版】1.0.3版本更新内容\n\n【重要】\n搜刮度的设计已经废除，现在全.en:
【Full Release】Version 1.0.3 Update

【Important】
Loot Progress has been removed; drop rate now remains at 300% throughout.
Loot Progress has been changed to Exploration Progress. When full, this chapter's Treasure sites automatically refresh.
Temple Baptism now lets you lock and unlock Talents by clicking them.
Preferred Skills now also apply to Baptism.
[Agony Scales] are no longer useful and will be converted back into Abyssal Scales in the next update.
Monster strength reduced by about 15%.
Boar Boss and Mushroom Boss Attack reduced by 15%.
Normal chapters now drop a small amount of Bone.

【Improvements】
Market no longer refreshes duplicate Order requirements.
More Attributes now show all attributes by default.
Uruk set Shields are temporarily counted on the set ring.
Skill tags have been moved above skill info for clearer visibility.

【Balance】
[Dark Star] crafting cost reduced to 6.
The value of individual Resistance affixes has been increased.
EXP required to level up reduced by 20%.
[Gazing Eye] drop rate increased by 50%.
EXP level penalty reduced to 10% per level, with a minimum of 10% EXP retained.
High-level Forging costs reduced by about 25%
High-quality Prisoner recruitment costs reduced by about 25%

【Fixes】
Fixed some Legendary items that could not be Refined into the corresponding Mythic.
Fixed Refined Mythic Equipment not being correctly recorded in the Codex.
Fixed Divine Tower sometimes being unable to proceed to the next floor.
Fixed duplicate Words of Runes for [Barrage Fire] and [Boomerang Blade].
Fixed incorrect stats for [Divine Power].
Fixed Priest [Chastise] missing the Debuff tag.
Fixed Temple Inspire incorrectly showing as full.
Fixed an error caused by clearing Outlands.
Fixed Rare Rune Pouches and Legendary Rune Pouches not being craftable in the Workshop.

【试玩版】0.2.21.0版本更新\n\n【优化】\n悬浮模式现在会基于桌面分辨.en:
[Demo] Version 0.2.21.0 Update

[Optimizations]
Floating mode now scales based on desktop resolution, preventing it from appearing too large at lower resolutions.
Floating mode can now use the mouse wheel to adjust the floating orb size.

[Fixes]
Fixed an issue where the Gift timer could stop after switching to floating orb mode.
Fixed an issue where falling projectiles could be released off-screen.
Fixed an issue where health bars could briefly flash when entering combat.
Fixed an issue where reopening the game after exiting in floating orb mode could show a small window.

懸浮模式現在可以使用滾輪調整懸浮球大小。

修復墜落型彈幕可能在螢幕外釋放的問題。

[Demo] Version 0.3.4.0 Update

[New]
Added Build Recommendations; more will be added later.
Added 12 basic Equipment appearances.
Added new Equipment [Shadow Veil].
Added new Equipment [Temporal Cadence].
Added Mythic Equipment [Silent Hunter].
Added some building Renovation icons.
Added Temple building animation effects.

[Improvements]
Improved the skill info UI display.
Improved Forging and Blessing multiplier toggle buttons.
Forging and Blessing now remember the selected multiplier.
Improved resource display overflowing the UI.
Added feature descriptions to the Worshiper UI.
Improved the building Renovation list display.
Added feature descriptions to Storage.
Forged Equipment now sells for a higher price.
Renamed All Attributes affixes to Primary Attributes to avoid confusion.

[Balance]
Strengthened the effect of Legendary Equipment [Dreamweaver].
Adjusted the effect of Legendary Equipment [Miser].
Modified the effect of Unique Equipment [Demonhide].
Cleric Specialization [Conquest] gained a new effect.
Cleric Specialization [Divine Grace] gained a new effect.
Cleric Specialization [Awakening] gained a new effect.
Cleric Specialization [Banish] gained a new effect.
Mercenary Specialization [Poise] effect increased.
Legendary Equipment [Rainbow] Legendary effect slightly reduced.
Mythic Equipment [Titan's Grip] Mythic effect slightly reduced.
Mythic Equipment [Ghoulhide] Mythic effect slightly reduced.
Mythic Equipment [Power of the Stars] Mythic effect slightly reduced.
Temple Baptism probabilities slightly adjusted.
Temple Blessing chance to gain Talents slightly reduced.
Skill Mana Cost scaling with level slightly increased.

[Fixes]
Fixed some UI text overflowing its bounds.
Fixed Health Tenacity attribute text display.
Fixed Preferred Skill incorrectly affecting Baptism.
Fixed an error caused by changes to Legendary Equipment [Rebirth].
Fixed UI lockups caused by dragging.
Fixed incorrect building Renovation names.
Fixed Godsworn detailed attribute display.
Fixed several multilanguage localization issues.

在本章内每击败一波怪物增加一点探索度。\n探索度满了之后，会自动重置当前章节的宝.en:
In this chapter, defeating a wave of monsters grants 1 Exploration Progress.
When Exploration Progress is full, this chapter's Treasures are automatically reset.
After Treasures reset, Exploration Progress starts accumulating again.

探索度滿了之後，會自動重置當前章節的寶藏。
重置寶藏後探索度也會重新累計。

本次测试为核心玩法测试，游戏内容暂不完整，部分玩法、剧情、美术资源仍在迭代优化中，可能存在卡顿、BUG、功能缺失等问题，给您带来的不佳体验我们深表歉意。

感谢您抽出宝贵时间参与测试，您的每一次体验、每一条反馈，都是我们打磨游戏的重要动力。测试期间若遇到问题或有改进建议，可通过游戏内反馈渠道告知我们。我们将持续迭代优化，努力为您呈现更完整、优质的游戏体验。

欢迎体验《放置之路》测试版本！\n\n本次测试为核心玩法测试，游戏内容暂不完整，.en:
Welcome to the test version of Idle Road!

This is a core gameplay test. The game content is not yet complete; some gameplay features, story elements, and art assets are still being iterated and optimized. You may encounter performance issues, bugs, or missing features, and we sincerely apologize for any negative experience caused.

Thank you for taking your precious time to participate in the test. Every moment you play and every feedback you provide is an important motivation for us to polish the game. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvement during the test, please let us know via the in-game feedback channel. We will continue to iterate and optimize, striving to deliver a more complete and high-quality gaming experience.

Thank you again for your understanding, support, and company. Enjoy your test!

Welcome to the demo of Idle Road!

This demo unlocks our core gameplay content. The full version will feature more levels, equipment, progression systems and brand-new modes. The game is still being polished and optimized, and we will keep improving its quality and experience.

Thank you for playing our game. Your feedback and suggestions are important for us to make it better. If you have any ideas, you can share them via the in-game feedback channel.

Thank you again for your support. We hope you enjoy your game!

启迪说明增加【黑暗星辰】的获取途径。
快速放入满仓库页时，多余的会放入下一页。
界面关闭红叉变的更明显了。
终焉说明增加污染位置的说明。

【调整】
传说装备【训犬者】移除了独特的获取途径。

降低了高层异界的怪物强度。
降低终焉所有阶段的怪物前度。
第二件神话装备改为90级可以穿戴。

【修复】
修复可以能出现章节关卡显示错误的问题。
修复缺少的精通技能速度的属性描述。
修复改名字会被战斗结算打断的问题。
修复查看属性信息回呗战斗结算打断的问题。

修复在改名的时候会响应快捷键的问题。

[Full Release] Version 1.0.5 Update, more improvements still underway!

[Important]
Blessing now grants 1 Talent Point every 5 levels, up to 6 points, with no random rolls.
After updating, reset Talents to apply the new Blessing Talent Points.
[Crystallized Skull] now changes Mutated Skills.
[Crystallized Skull] combine cost reduced to 6.

[New]
Market adds auto configuration: filter by Socket count and Auto-Buy.
Equipment comparison now shows Affix changes.
Mutated Skills and Inspire Masteries gain unique frames.

[Improvements]
[Dark Star] can now be used directly in the Inspire UI.
Clarified confusing equipment descriptions.
Removed [Agony Scales] combine from Sanctum Upgrades.
Added a prompt when Orders equipment list is missing items.
Improved inaccurate Corrupt feature descriptions.
Clarified Cleric [Divine Shelter] skill targeting.
Inspire tips now include how to obtain [Dark Star].
Quick-stashing into a full Warehouse page puts overflow on the next page.
The UI close X is more visible.
Doom tips now mention where to Corrupt equipment.

[Balance]
Legendary equipment [Dog Trainer] unique acquisition removed.
Reduced monster strength on high Divine Tower floors.
Reduced monster strength in high Outlands.
Reduced monster strength across all Doom stages.
The second Mythic equipment can now be equipped at level 90.

[Fixes]
Fixed possible incorrect chapter stage display.
Fixed missing Mastery Skill Speed attribute description.
Fixed rename being interrupted by combat settlement.
Fixed viewing attribute info being interrupted by combat settlement.
Fixed Mythic equipment [Master] damage stats display issues.
Fixed localization-related issues.
Fixed Corrupt equipment causing skewed item display.
Fixed [Winter's Embrace] becoming the wrong Mythic after Refining.
Fixed hotkeys responding while renaming.

【正式版】1.0.6.1版本更新内容\n\n【重要】\n词缀封印进行了大幅减轻负.en:
[Full Release] Version 1.0.6.1 Update

[Important]
Affix Seals have been greatly streamlined!!!
Set seals on the Rare Codex, then sync them to the corresponding higher-quality Codexes.
Higher-quality Codexes can still have seals set separately.
Higher-quality Codexes no longer have Awareness progress; Awareness Level stays in sync with the matching Rare Codex.
Obtaining higher-quality equipment now grants more Awareness to the matching Rare Codex.
Awareness Level keeps the highest level from before the merge.

[Improvements]
Added Outlands Star Map quest tips.
Improved the prompt for equipping 2 Mythics.
Improved right-click replace equipment in the Workshop.
Improved right-click replace equipment when Corrupting at the Stele.
Legendary and Mythic Godsworn recruited before Mutated Skills unlock can now gain Mutated Skills via [Crystallized Skull].
Clarified Legendary Chest descriptions.

[Fixes]
Fixed incorrect base Affixes on some higher-quality equipment.
Fixed possible incorrect equipment stat comparison display.
Fixed incorrect close order when pressing ESC on the Affix Seal UI.
Fixed Mage Mastery [Convert] Shields not being counted.
Fixed some Mastery descriptions overflowing their frames.
Fixed incorrect Priest skill [Bone Chill] description.
Fixed equipment animations getting stuck after leaving Floating Mode.
